issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 asks for the average (Durchschnitt) of female and male inhabitants grouped by Regierungsbezirk, but the solution query uses SUM(einwohner_w) and SUM(einwohner_m) instead of AVG(...). This is a semantic/structural mismatch in the aggregate operation: students following the problem will implement AVG but the provided solution uses SUM, which will cause confusion and failing equivalence checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the problem specification by using AVG for the aggregates. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, AVG(einwohner_w), AVG(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk. Alternatively, if sums were intended, update the problem text to request the SUM instead of the Durchschnitt.
